notes.title: Boom Co by Burt's Games to pause production
notes.content:
[h1]Boom Co by Burt's Games to pause production[/h1]

BOOM COMPANY, the forthcoming debut of Asia-headquartered independent developer Burt's Games has paused production.

The team behind the sci-fi action title regrets to share that, due to circumstances beyond their control, the production of the game, BOOM Company, will not proceed as planned. 

Unforeseeable circumstances, including the loss of their lead game designer due to unfortunate and personal events, have made it impossible for the team to continue with their scheduled production.

During this time of transition, the team will take a pause to reassess their next steps.

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at [b]marketing@burtsgames.com
[/b]

notes.title: Update as of June 2022
notes.content:
As we wrap up the first half of 2022, we wanted to give everyone the low-down on what’s been happening.

We released a demo of Boom Company earlier this year to let select players get a crack at our twin-stick shooter. The demo included a mini-run of the game, which comprised ten stages and a boss fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244871/7ff85313e3566be7e0e7278d9304b66b28387645.png[/img]

We also joined [url=https://www.ign.com/events/rogue-jam]IGN’s Rogue Jam[/url] a few months back and [url=https://www.ign.com/videos/these-are-the-most-eye-poppingly-beautiful-games-in-rogue-jam]became one of the three finalists for the "Eye-Poppingly Beautiful" category[/url]. You can view their [url=https://www.ign.com/videos/boom-company-preview-rogue-jam]gamplay preview of our game here[/url], too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244871/5c1ece40c65b21d454a8016a44686b90aaad4b9f.png[/img]

At the moment, we are making adjustments to the game based on all the feedback that we received. The two things we are most focused on are gameplay difficulty and creating more content. The team is working tirelessly to tighten the game up and upgrade the loop. A ton of new content (gameplay and story-wise) is in production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244871/eda54c636147a02e7d5369d8336139edc8010895.png[/img]

Thank you all for the continued support. Don’t forget to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/NPVAsKGhkD]Discord[/url] for more sporadic updates.

notes.title: Boom Company is live on Kickstarter
notes.content:
[h1]Boom Company is now Live on Kickstarter
[/h1]

[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244871/092e23e8e15ada8126dbd047a9c708215e3ad1e2.jpg[/img]

We are extremely excited to bring to the world our very first game and we need your support to make BOOM COMPANY a reality! Check out all the pledges that we have curated for you. With your support, we can bring them ALL to life.

The BoomCo campaign launched yesterday, 12 October 2021 and will run for 30 days, with a goal of
HK$ 150,000 (Approx $19,275). Early Bird perks include a [b]Stargazer reward[/b] with access to the [i]Digital Edition[/i] and the [b][i]Boom Company: Mini-Mission Demo[/i][/b] (which we will release when the campaign ends) for HK$120 (Approx. $16) and delivery worldwide.

Head over to our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/burtsgames/boom-company]Kickstarter project[/url] and choose among our awesome tiers now!
